game_concept: A strategy race set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the wall banner by solving code steps involving cases that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the wall banner first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
